# GERNAS attribute, span and metric reference (registry 2026.10.1)

Blueprint §2 field names are used verbatim under the `gernas.` namespace. SDK code refers to them only
through `gernas.Ctx`. `trace_id` / `span_id` are the native W3C span context.

## business (Blueprint §2 domain) — owner: FAB DAI

Business context binding every signal to a business domain, use case and application.

| Constant | Key | Type | Required | Sensitivity | Cardinality | Action | Source | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ctx.BUSINESS_DOMAIN` | `gernas.business_domain` | string | always | internal | bounded | keep | GERNAS-REQ-006 | Line of business that owns the use case |
| `Ctx.USE_CASE_ID` | `gernas.use_case_id` | string | always | internal | bounded | keep | GERNAS-REQ-006 | Registered GERNAS use-case identifier |
| `Ctx.APPLICATION_ID` | `gernas.application_id` | string | always | internal | bounded | keep | GERNAS-REQ-006 | Application hosting the use case |

## identity (Blueprint §2 domain) — owner: FAB Data Governance

Who initiated the work. The raw user id never leaves the process; only a keyed token does (Blueprint §2 critical principle).

| Constant | Key | Type | Required | Sensitivity | Cardinality | Action | Source | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ctx.USER_ID` | `gernas.user_id` | string | never | restricted | unbounded | drop | GERNAS-REQ-007 | Raw end-user identifier - accepted by request_context() but never emitted |
| `Ctx.TOKENIZED_USER_ID` | `gernas.tokenized_user_id` | string | conditional | confidential | unbounded | keep | GERNAS-REQ-007 | HMAC-SHA256 token of the user id (key from GERNAS_USER_TOKEN_KEY) |
| `Ctx.PRINCIPAL_TYPE` | `gernas.principal_type` | string (`human`, `agent`, `service`) | conditional | internal | bounded | keep | GERNAS-REQ-007 | Kind of principal that initiated the call |
| `Ctx.TENANT` | `gernas.tenant` | string | conditional | internal | bounded | keep | GERNAS-REQ-007 | Tenant or legal entity |
| `Ctx.DEPARTMENT` | `gernas.department` | string | conditional | internal | bounded | keep | GERNAS-REQ-007 | Department of the initiator |

## Spans

| Span name | API | Kind | Required attributes (plus envelope) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `use_case.request` | `trace_use_case` | SERVER | `gernas.use_case_id`, `gernas.application_id`, `gernas.business_domain` | GERNAS-REQ-021 |
| `agent.run` | `trace_agent` | INTERNAL | `gernas.agent_id`, `gernas.agent_name`, `gernas.agent_version`, `gernas.agent_type`, `gernas.agent_run_id`, `gernas.termination_reason`, `gernas.step_count`, `gernas.retry_count` | GERNAS-REQ-022 |
| `agent.step` | `trace_step` | INTERNAL | `gernas.step_id`, `gernas.step_type`, `gernas.attempt_number` | GERNAS-REQ-010 |
| `agent.plan` | `trace_planning` | INTERNAL | `gernas.plan_id`, `gernas.attempt_number` | GERNAS-REQ-022 |
| `agent.delegate` | `trace_delegation` | CLIENT | `gernas.parent_agent_id`, `gernas.child_agent_id`, `gernas.delegation_path` | GERNAS-REQ-023 |
| `llm.call` | `trace_llm` | CLIENT | `gernas.provider`, `gernas.model_id` | GERNAS-REQ-025 |
| `embedding.create` | `trace_embedding` | CLIENT | `gernas.provider`, `gernas.model_id`, `gernas.batch_size` | GERNAS-REQ-026 |
| `tool.call` | `trace_tool` | CLIENT | `gernas.tool_id`, `gernas.tool_type`, `gernas.authorization_decision` | GERNAS-REQ-024 |
| `retrieval.search` | `trace_retrieval` | CLIENT | `gernas.result_count`, `gernas.empty_result` | GERNAS-REQ-028 |
| `memory.access` | `trace_memory` | INTERNAL | `gernas.memory_operation` | GERNAS-REQ-029 |
| `guardrail.check` | `trace_guardrail` | INTERNAL | `gernas.policy_id`, `gernas.policy_decision` | GERNAS-REQ-015 |
| `content_safety.check` | `trace_content_safety` | INTERNAL | `gernas.safety_category`, `gernas.content_blocked` | GERNAS-REQ-027 |
| `document.process` | `trace_document` | INTERNAL | `gernas.document_type`, `gernas.document_status` | GERNAS-REQ-043 |
| `evaluation.score` | `record_evaluation` | INTERNAL | `gernas.evaluation_metric`, `gernas.evaluation_score` | GERNAS-REQ-041 |
| `hitl.approval` | `trace_hitl / start_hitl` | INTERNAL | `gernas.hitl_ticket_id`, `gernas.hitl_action`, `gernas.hitl_outcome` | GERNAS-REQ-031 |
| `{method} {route}` | `GernasASGIMiddleware` | SERVER | `http.request.method`, `http.route`, `http.response.status_code` | TN-03 |

Envelope on every span: `gernas.business_domain`, `gernas.use_case_id`, `gernas.application_id`, `gernas.environment`, `gernas.operation`, `gernas.execution_status`.
Additionally on every span inside an agent run: `gernas.agent_id`, `gernas.agent_run_id`.

Events: only the OpenTelemetry standard `exception` event.
